nodes.title: About this workflow
widgets_values:
# Scene · partner stills (Qwen-Image-Edit 2511, 8 edits in one job)

The Qwen *Multiple Character Angles* template with all 8 branches exposed: each branch has its own image (`img1..8`, or `image` for all), prompt (`p1..8`), seed (`s1..8`) and Multiple-Angles LoRA strength (`l1..8`, `angle_lora` for all; 0 = plain Qwen-Image-Edit). Scene uses it for partner B single, over-the-shoulder and close-up framings. One group per branch, top to bottom.

- Models: Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 bf16, Qwen 2.5 VL 7B fp8, Qwen-Image VAE, Lightning 4-step LoRA, Multiple-Angles LoRA



**Nodes in yellow are the ones the app sets on every job** (see `scene_edit_bindings.json`); every other value is exactly what the app submits. Each node keeps its API id in Properties → `api_id`.

This is a view of `workflows/scene_edit_api.json` (what the app sends to Comfy Cloud). All models are open weights; file names and download links: `workflows/README.md`.
